THE MODEL CARRIES REAL INFORMATION, IN THE OPPOSITE DIRECTION TO THE ONE PROPOSED.
After length and citations are removed, essentiality ANTI-predicts driver status at
0.2990 -- i.e. it predicts NON-drivers at 0.7010.
That is a genuine, interpretable finding (purifying selection keeps pan-essential genes
out of the driver list) and it is NOT what this module set out to show.
And the subset this model could mechanistically explain -- loss-of-function drivers --
sits at 0.5073, which is chance. The model can say what is not a driver. It cannot
say what is.
